author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
With the Razor Crest models completed and delivered to production, Adam embeds in the motion control stage at ILM to watch these miniatures be filmed and learn about John Knoll's latest motion control setup. Adam also pays a set visit to Skywalker Ranch where the larger Razor Crest model gets its day in the sun, with a special apperance by Jon Favreau!

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
